name: Andrew Miller
title: Founder, Miller's Marketing Group
bio: Andrew grew up in Kingston, Jamaica, where he learned early that opportunity often begins with resourcefulness, trust, and people willing to help one another. That belief still shapes MMG today.
Part strategist, part host, and part connector, Andrew listens, makes thoughtful introductions, and keeps showing up for Florida's personal injury professional community.
quote: Marketing is more than ads. It is about alignment, connection, and clarity.
